title: Antigravity CLI Monitoring
description: Comprehensive monitoring for Google Antigravity CLI (agy) agent sessions, tools, loop invocations, models, and weekly quotas via OpenTelemetry.

panels.title: Total Conversations
panels.description: Distinct interactive conversations seen in the selected window

queries.query: SELECT count(distinct gen_ai_conversation_id) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'antigravity-cli' AND agy_hook_event IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Tool Calls Over Time
panels.description: Timeline of tool executions by tool name

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x_axis_1, gen_ai_tool_name as x_axis_2, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'antigravity-cli' AND agy_hook_event = 'PostToolUse' AND gen_ai_tool_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Top Tools
panels.description: Most frequently executed tools ranked by number of calls

queries.query: SELECT gen_ai_tool_name as tool_name, count(*) as calls, count(distinct gen_ai_conversation_id) as conversations FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'antigravity-cli' AND agy_hook_event = 'PostToolUse' AND gen_ai_tool_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY gen_ai_tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Agent Loop Invocations
panels.description: Frequency of passes through the agent loop over time

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'antigravity-cli' AND agy_hook_event = 'PostInvocation' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Requests by Model
panels.description: Distribution of LLM models serving Antigravity requests

queries.query: SELECT gen_ai_request_model as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'antigravity-cli' AND agy_hook_event = 'PostInvocation' AND gen_ai_request_model IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Why Turns Ended
panels.description: Agent turn completion reasons (NO_TOOL_CALL, ERROR, USER_CANCELED, etc.)

queries.query: SELECT agy_termination_reason as x_axis_1, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'antigravity-cli' AND agy_hook_event = 'Stop' AND agy_termination_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: Turns Completed Over Time
panels.description: Volume of finished agent turns grouped by model

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x_axis_1, gen_ai_request_model as x_axis_2, count(*) as y_axis_1 FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'antigravity-cli' AND agy_hook_event = 'Stop' GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Recent Turns Log
panels.description: Latest completed agent turns with status and conversation IDs

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, agy_termination_reason, gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_conversation_id, agy_execution_num, agy_fully_idle FROM "default" WHERE service_name = 'antigravity-cli' AND agy_hook_event = 'Stop' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Gemini Quota Remaining (%)
panels.description: Weekly Gemini quota burn rate over time expressed as percentage (0% to 100%)

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) as x_axis_1, round(max(value) * 100, 1) as y_axis_1 FROM "agy_quota_remaining_fraction" WHERE agy_quota_bucket = 'gemini-weekly' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Current Quota Status (%)
panels.description: Current remaining quota percentage by bucket and group (0% to 100%)

queries.query: SELECT agy_quota_bucket as bucket, agy_quota_group as group_name, round(max(value) * 100, 1) as remaining_quota_pct FROM "agy_quota_remaining_fraction" GROUP BY bucket, group_name

panels.title: Days Until Quota Reset
panels.description: Days remaining until quota window fully resets (converted from seconds)

queries.query: SELECT agy_quota_bucket as bucket, round(max(value) / 86400.0, 1) as days_to_reset FROM "agy_quota_seconds_to_reset" GROUP BY bucket
